## Paired Means

### Dataset & Null Hypothesis Sampling Distribution

You'll work with a dataset called `climate70` about the number of days with temperatures above 90 degrees across a variety of weather stations in both 1948 and 2018. All the weather stations have data for the number of days above 90 degrees in both years. 

Run the code below to see a random 10 rows of the dataset.

```{code-blanks}
slice_sample(climate70, n = 10)
```

Answer Questions 17-19 of your packet, then fill in this code to calculate the difference variable.

```{code-blanks}
#| blank:
#|   target: dx90_2018
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token
#| blank:
#|   target: dx90_1948
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token

climate70_diff <- climate70 |>
  mutate(dx90_diff = dx90_2018 - dx90_1948)

head(climate70_diff)

```

Answer Questions 20-21 in your packet. Then fill in the code below and use the distribution to answer Question 22.

```{code-blanks}
#| blank:
#|   target: dx90_diff
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token
#| blank:
#|   target: mean
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token
#| blank:
#|   target: "paired independence"
#|   prefill: true
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token

null_dist <- climate70_diff |>
  specify(response = dx90_diff) |>
  hypothesize(null = "paired independence") |>
  generate(reps = 5000, type = "permute") |>
  calculate(stat = "mean")

visualize(null_dist)

```

**Stop** and check in with Dr. O or Aidan here.

## Investigating the Sample

Fill in the following two code chunks, and use them to answer Questions 23-24.

```{code-blanks}
#| blank:
#|   target: dx90_diff
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token
#| blank:
#|   target: mean
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token

sample_stat <- climate70_diff |>
  specify(response = dx90_diff) |>
  calculate(stat = "mean")

sample_stat

```

```{code-blanks}
#| blank:
#|   target: dx90_diff
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token
#| blank:
#|   target: geom_histogram
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token

ggplot(climate70_diff) +
  aes(x = dx90_diff) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=2) +
  labs(
    x = "Difference in Number of 90 Degree Days (2018 - 1948)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

## Finding the p-value

Answer Question 25 in your packet, then fill in the code below to answer Questions 26 and 27.

```{code-blanks}
#| blank:
#|   target: right
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token
#| blank:
#|   target: sample_stat
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token
#| blank:
#|   target: right
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token
#| blank:
#|   target: sample_stat
#|   prefill: false
#|   occurrence: 1
#|   match: token

null_dist |>
  visualize() + 
  shade_p_value(sample_stat, direction = "right")

null_dist |>
  get_p_value(sample_stat, direction = "right")

```
